from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_24_A, prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_24_B, prompt_custom.WORKER_COORD_24_C],
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.COORDINATE_24,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.VERIFY_24_STAGE1, prompt_custom.VERIFY_24_STAGE2])
        solution = await seq(problem + "\n\nCandidate draft:\n" + (draft["response"] or "```text\ncannot form 24\n```"))
        worker_usage = self.llm.get_usage_delta()
        aggregator_usage = self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() if self.aggregator_llm is not self.llm else {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0}
        return solution["response"] or "```text\ncannot form 24\n```", {
            "worker": worker_usage or {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0},
            "aggregator": aggregator_usage or {"total_input_tokens": 0, "total_output_tokens": 0, "total_cost": 0.0},
        }
